annotator: Coding agent manual evidence audit; independent human review pending
selection: All five nondeleted library papers with indexed full text on 2026-09-15. No synthetic papers.
unit: Paper-method presence, not sentence detection or number of mentions.
scope: All methods in the frozen initial taxonomy. Unlisted labels are negative after reading Methods and relevant Results. New taxonomy labels are reported separately and unscored.
rules: Label methods actually used in the focal experiments, not cited work, background biology, or discussion proposals.
Ordinary housing, ad libitum feeding, serum storage vials and surgical guide cannulae do not establish diet, pharmacokinetic or intracranial-drug manipulations.
Temperature measured but not analysed in Gannon2023 counts as a measurement, with its sentence retained.
Repeated experiments, counterbalanced interventions, and sampled time courses are labelled by study design even when the exact taxonomy word is absent.
Dose-response requires a deliberate dose comparison, not just a dose printed in a methods sentence.
No inferential significance tests: small convenience corpus and non-independent method labels only support descriptive accuracy.
notes: The library metadata date for the Lomax paper differs from the PDF (1990); source metadata is left untouched. Labels use DOI, title and text hashes.
